subject: Social Science
scopeBoundary: Fourteen-chapter curriculum mapping with independently authored Kiki teaching implementation for Chapters 1-6 and separate synthetic school-needs validation for Chapters 1-5. Chapter 6 teaching and deterministic assessments are implemented, but Chapter 6 school-needs validation remains pending. No NCERT textbook prose, exercises, live-school evidence or subject-completion claim is included.

officialSource.officialPortalCurrentObservation: The NCERT textbook portal currently exposes the title and chapter links in its rendered Class VI shelf; the portal rendering observed during reconciliation showed twelve chapter links.
officialSource.publicationListEvidence: The NCERT publication list identifies Exploring Society: India and Beyond as Social Science Textbook for Class VI (code 0681).
officialSource.chapterCountDiscrepancy: The rendered NCERT portal shelf observed during the earlier reconciliation exposed 12 chapter links, while current 2026-27 chapter-index evidence identifies 14 chapters. The mapping therefore treats 14 as the working current textbook structure and preserves the discrepancy explicitly.

corroboratingCurrentStructure.use: Corroboration only; NCERT remains the canonical publisher/source authority.

chapters.title: Oceans and Continents
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People
chapters.implementationBoundary: Independently authored land/water distribution; five interconnected oceans; continents/islands and counting conventions; and oceans' importance, human impact and protection. No copied textbook prose, exercises, maps or figures.

chapters.title: Landforms and Life
chapters.theme: Theme A — India and the World: Land and the People
chapters.implementationBoundary: Independently authored major-landform classification; mountains and human choices; plateaus and resource choices; plains, rivers and flood-aware adaptation. Geography is non-deterministic, privacy-safe and does not copy textbook prose, exercises, maps or figures.

chapters.title: Timeline and Sources of History
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past
chapters.implementationBoundary: Independently authored investigation of the human past; chronology and historical time; source classification and corroboration; and cautious evidence-based reasoning about early communities and change. No copied textbook prose, exercises, source extracts, images or page layouts; no sensitive family, religion, caste, community, ancestry or precise migration disclosure requirement.

chapters.title: India, That Is Bharat
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past
chapters.implementationBoundary: Independently authored geographical/historical framing; source-aware interpretation of names used within the subcontinent; cross-cultural language transmission of names; and factual modern constitutional India/Bharat framing. No copied textbook prose, exercises, maps, figures or source extracts; no party-political advocacy, territorial advocacy, patriotic loyalty testing or sensitive identity disclosure requirement.

chapters.title: The Beginnings of Indian Civilisation
chapters.theme: Theme B — Tapestry of the Past
chapters.implementationBoundary: Independently authored civilisation-as-evidence model; Harappan settlement and urban evidence; food, craft, water and exchange systems; and evidence-aware transformation or decline. No copied textbook prose, exercises, maps, site plans, figures, photographs or source extracts; no civilisational superiority, modern identity projection, speculative script decoding or single-cause decline claim.

rightsAndSafetyBoundary: Use chapter titles and structural metadata for mapping only.
Do not reproduce NCERT textbook prose or exercise questions.
Kiki teaching explanations, examples, assessments, remediation and mastery evidence are independently authored.
Do not claim SAN Academy-specific textbook alignment without direct evidence.
Do not collect or request a learner's precise real-world location for geographic activities.
Do not use landforms to make deterministic claims about occupations, cultures or communities.
Do not require sensitive family, religion, caste, community, address, photograph, recording, ancestry, migration or political-opinion disclosures for history activities.
Do not present uncertain historical or archaeological interpretations as established fact.
Do not use Chapter 5 for contemporary party-political advocacy, territorial claims or patriotic loyalty testing.
Do not use Chapter 6 to rank civilisations, project modern identities backward, assert speculative script readings, or present one uncertain decline hypothesis as settled fact.
Do not claim whole-Class-6 or Social Science completion.
